title: Desk Reference for Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44): Filing Reasons, Open-Filing Limit and Carrier Transfers
content:
### Filing reasons

Every Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) filing is requested for one of five controlled reasons. The list is the same for all six certificates.

- new requirement
- reinstatement refiling
- state change
- carrier transfer
- corrected refiling

### Open-filing limit

One driver may hold at most 1 open filing with one state, for every certificate. A filing counts as open while its status is requested, rejected, filed or cancellation-filed.

**Scope of the limit.** A new request for the same driver and state while one is open is refused, except a reinstatement refiling, or a state change refiling after a move, either of which is allowed while the earlier filing is cancellation-filed and replaces it.

*Hypothetical:* a driver holds a filed SR-22 certificate with Georgia. A new-requirement request for that driver with Georgia is refused while the Georgia filing is open. A request for the same driver with Arizona is a different state, so it is not counted against the Georgia filing.

### Carrier transfer

When the filer moves the requirement to Cardinal Point from another carrier, the new filing is requested with the reason carrier transfer. The prior carrier sends its own SR-26. This applies to all six certificates.
